settings.heading: Description
settings.content:
Strong, clean and unbelievably smooth, O'Donnell Moonshine High High Proof offers the ultimate in authentic Moonshine experiences.

With the unmistakable strength often associated with traditional Moonshine spirits, our overproof Moonshine will surprise with it's smooth finish courtesy of premium ingredients, thorough filtering and triple distillation.

The perfect companion for any number of cocktails, this one is sure to give you a true flavour of the prohibition.

Bottled in traditional Mason Jars, we promise a unique drinking experience. If you would like to discover more high quality liqueurs, have a look at our entire product range. Become part of our Moonshine Gang to collect proof points and unlock unique benefits.

For those new to Moonshine, it was the name given to illegally produced grain alcohol distilled during the American Prohibition. It was traditionally bottled in Mason Jars to avoid detection by the authorities. O’Donnell Moonshine retains the rebellious nature of that era, while delivering a whole new world of flavour in our range of smooth and delicious liqueurs.

*Consult our FAQ's for more information.
Please Note: All of our products are shipped in branded boxes.

settings.heading: Moonshine Must Haves
settings.content: Grab one of our reusable Moonshine Pouring Lids, so that you don't lose a drop!

settings.heading: Perfect Serve
settings.content: For a pure Moonshine experience, add a large measure to a short glass with ice and sip slowly, alternatively mix with premium tonic and a slice of fresh lemon for a longer drink.

settings.heading: Allergens
settings.content:
All of our Moonshines, unless indicated otherwise, are allergen free in accordance with Regulation (EU) No 1169/2011 and amendments. All of our products, unless stated otherwise, are suitable for vegans and those with a gluten intolerance.

All of our spirits are produced using wheat based alcohol. While the distillation process removes gluten from the final product, individuals with certain conditions (i.e coeliac disease) may wish to exercise caution prior to purchase.
